close_reason: Created submission.rs with all 5 EmailSubmission/* methods; added EmailSubmissionSetParams to mod.rs; exported from lib.rs; 11 unit tests (guards + request shapes + response deserialization)
description:
**What:** Create crate-jmap-mail-client/src/methods/submission.rs with all 5 EmailSubmission methods on SessionClient. Add EmailSubmissionSetParams to mod.rs. Wire up exports. Oracle: RFC 8621 §7.1-7.5.

**New types in mod.rs:**
pub struct EmailSubmissionSetParams {
    #[serde(skip_serializing_if = "Option::is_none")]
    pub on_success_update_email: Option<serde_json::Value>,  // Id[PatchObject]|null
    #[serde(skip_serializing_if = "Option::is_none")]
    pub on_success_destroy_email: Option<Vec<String>>,       // Id[]|null
}

**Methods to implement:**
1. email_submission_get(ids: Option<&[&str]>, properties: Option<&[&str]>) -> Result<GetResponse<jmap_mail_types::EmailSubmission>, ClientError>
   - Guard: reject empty strings in ids. Args: accountId, ids, properties.
2. email_submission_changes(since_state: &str, max_changes: Option<u64>) -> Result<ChangesResponse, ClientError>
   - Guard: since_state non-empty. Args: accountId, sinceState, optional maxChanges.
3. email_submission_query(filter, sort, position, limit) -> Result<QueryResponse, ClientError>
   - Args: accountId, optional filter/sort/position/limit. No collapseThreads.
4. email_submission_query_changes(since_query_state: &str, max_changes, filter, sort) -> Result<QueryChangesResponse, ClientError>
   - Guard: since_query_state non-empty.
5. email_submission_set(create, update, destroy, if_in_state, params: Option<EmailSubmissionSetParams>) -> Result<SetResponse<jmap_mail_types::EmailSubmission>, ClientError>
   - Guard: reject empty strings in destroy. Merge params fields into args JSON.
   - Wire key for sort is "sentAt" (not "sendAt") per RFC 8621 §7.3 line 4513.

**Unit tests in submission.rs:** empty-id guard, empty-state guard, request shape for each method, onSuccessUpdateEmail in set request body.

**Algorithm for each method:** validate → session_parts() → build args → build_request(..., USING_MAIL) → call_internal → extract_response.

**Acceptance criteria:**
- cargo test -p jmap-mail-client exits 0.
- All 5 methods present on SessionClient.
- EmailSubmissionSetParams exported from lib.rs.
- Wire keys match RFC 8621 §7: identityId, emailId, sendAt (object field), sentAt (sort property), onSuccessUpdateEmail, onSuccessDestroyEmail.
